candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: Zodiac Hurricane Technologies gains a specific operating context for custom RHIB manufacture and boat sustainment, replacing generic readiness prose. Evidence: 9 durable sources from Zodiac Milpro, CanadaBuys, National Defence, Public Services and Procurement Canada and Argos distinguish products, awards and procurement access. Mission/Public Need read: no new Mission or Public Need match is proposed; custom RHIB manufacture and boat sustainment support maritime engagement without proving autonomous or Arctic sensing fit. Unknowns: configuration-specific acceptance, Canadian workshare and subsidiary financing remain unverified. Reviewer action: review the operating context, capability sustainment addition and July 2026 current activity as ready_for_editorial_v1; verify delivery quantities before strengthening deployment claims.
reviewWarnings: Configuration-specific acceptance, Canadian workshare, delivery quantities and subsidiary financing remain unverified. Group product options and investor activity do not establish every Delta-built configuration or Canadian investment.
